settings.title: Care for the way
settings.intro: From acute injuries to chronic pain, we see the whole picture. Here's a snapshot of the conditions we help people overcome every week.

features.title: Back & neck pain
features.text: Disc issues, sciatica, and the desk-job stiffness that creeps up on you. We find the driver and build a plan that holds.

features.title: Sports injuries
features.text: Sprains, strains, and overuse injuries from running, lifting, and team sports. Get back to training with a plan, not a guess.

features.title: Post-surgical rehab
features.text: Knee, shoulder, and hip replacements and repairs. We coordinate with your surgeon to rebuild strength safely and steadily.

features.title: Joint pain & arthritis
features.text: Knees, hips, and hands that ache. We reduce pain and improve function so you can keep doing what you love.

features.title: Headaches & migraines
features.text: Tension and cervicogenic headaches that start in the neck. Targeted treatment that often reduces frequency and intensity.

features.title: Balance & falls prevention
features.text: For older adults and anyone feeling unsteady. We improve strength and balance to keep you confident on your feet.

settings.title: A method, not
settings.intro: Great physio is a process. Here's how we take you from pain to confident movement.

design.title: Thorough assessment
design.text: A full hour with your physio: your history, a movement screen, and a clear diagnosis. You leave knowing what's wrong and why.

build.title: Hands-on treatment
build.text: Manual therapy, dry needling, and targeted exercise — combined into a plan that addresses the root cause, not just the pain.

launch.title: A plan that lasts
launch.text: You get a home program and clear milestones. We check in, adjust, and graduate you when you're strong enough to stay well on your own.

settings.title: From first visit
settings.intro: Getting started is simple, and the first step is always a conversation.

steps.title: Book your assessment
steps.text: Call or book online. We'll ask a few questions to match you with the right physio and get you scheduled — usually within 48 hours.

steps.title: Get a clear diagnosis
steps.text: In your first hour-long session, we assess, explain what's going on, and lay out a plan. You'll know exactly what we're doing and why.

steps.title: Start your treatment
steps.text: Hands-on care and a targeted exercise program, reviewed and progressed at every visit. Most patients feel meaningful change within 3–4 sessions.

steps.title: Stay strong for good
steps.text: We don't just discharge you — we make sure you have the tools to stay well. Follow-up and maintenance plans keep you moving.

settings.note: Most patients see meaningful improvement within 3–4 sessions, and we review your progress together at every visit so you always know where things stand.

settings.title: Questions patients
settings.intro: The honest answers to the questions we hear most often before someone books their first appointment.

items.question: Do I need a referral to see a physio?
items.answer: No. In most states you can see a physiotherapist directly without a referral. We'll help you understand your coverage and, if your condition needs a doctor, we'll point you in the right direction.

items.question: Will my insurance cover it?
items.answer: Most major insurance plans cover physiotherapy. We verify your benefits before your first visit and offer direct billing to most providers, so you know exactly what you'll pay upfront.

items.question: How many sessions will I need?
items.answer: It depends on your condition, but most patients see meaningful improvement within 3–4 sessions. We give you a clear plan and honest expectations from day one — no endless treatment with no end in sight.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Comfortable, loose clothing you can move in. For lower-body issues, shorts are helpful. We have private treatment rooms and can provide gowns if needed.

items.question: What if it hurts during treatment?
items.answer: You should never be in significant pain during a session. We work within your comfort level and communicate constantly. Some soreness after treatment is normal, but we'll always tell you what to expect.
